category_edits.rationale: Test a smaller adjustment: reduce causal pooled-state contribution from 20% to 18%, retaining the three-interaction half-life. This differs from the previously evaluated 15% and 25% configurations. Apply the shared readout across all four datasets and synchronize predictor metadata while preserving padding exclusion, causality, final-real-position inference and the GRU backbone.

response.change_summary: Change the causal GRU readout to 82% current state and 18% pooled state, retain half-life 3, and synchronize checkpoint and embedded predictor metadata.
